sahneler.metin: A munitions pier in California exploded as ships were being loaded.
The blast destroyed both ships and the pier, killing three hundred twenty men.
Loading was racing to meet targets.
Most sailors had no training in handling explosives.
Survivors who then refused unsafe work were court-martialled.
The case became a landmark in civil rights history.
The Navy changed its munitions-handling procedures.

aciklama:
Port Chicago exploded while ships were being loaded with munitions. The cause: detonation of explosives during hurried, poorly supervised loading.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
